#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int a, b, c, d, e;
    Point(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) : a(a), b(b), c(c), d(d), e(e) {}
    Point sub(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(a - o.a, b - o.b, c - o.c, d - o.d, e - o.e);
    }
    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(a*a + b*b + c*c + d*d + e*e);
    }
};

bool acute(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double dot = a.a*b.a + a.b*b.b + a.c*b.c + a.d*b.d + a.e*b.e;
    double ang = acos(dot / (a.mag() * b.mag()));
    return (ang * 180.0 / M_PI) < 90.0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<Point> pts;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        pts.emplace_back(a, b, c, d, e);
    }
    
    vector<int> good;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool bad = false;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && !bad; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < n && !bad; k++) {
                if (i == k || j == k) continue;
                Point v1 = pts[j].sub(pts[i]);
                Point v2 = pts[k].sub(pts[i]);
                if (acute(v1, v2)) {
                    bad = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!bad) good.push_back(i + 1);
    }
    
    if (good.empty()) {
        cout << "0\n";
    } else {
        cout << good.size() << "\n";
        for (int x : good) cout << x << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}
